ValidationRule.description: Ticket No. and EMD No. format must only be 13 digit
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR ( ( NOT(ISBLANK( CPN_Used_on_EMD_No__c )) && NOT(REGEX( CPN_Used_on_EMD_No__c , "[0-9]{13}")) ), ( NOT(ISBLANK( CPN_Used_on_TKT_No__c )) && NOT(REGEX( CPN_Used_on_TKT_No__c , "[0-9]{13}")) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter Ticket No. and EMD No. in the 13 digit format
